_comment: Behavioral-eval fixture for /marketing:new-persona (BC-12915, ADR-028 structure-first / LLM-judged). Driven through the REAL runtime entrypoint canonicals_bootstrap.py persona (which OWNS every input guard) against a copy of the SHARED frozen seed in new-offer-seed/ (vertical 'sample-vertical' with personas 'ops-director' + 'facilities-manager', so duplicate_slug has a deterministic collision). Structure-first proof: the WRITTEN canonical (seed + appended persona) passes lint_canonicals' full contract and the appended entry's slug/display match inputs (titles is a comma-string input -> parsed list, golden-locked). Each row isolates ONE builder-owned guard (slug -> vertical -> duplicate).

scenarios.note: clean append: a new, unique persona with a titles list into an existing vertical -> lints clean + fields match.
exact-match dedup: a slug SIMILAR to the seed's 'ops-director' but DIFFERENT must NOT collide -> still writes, still lints clean.
uniqueness guard (builder-owned): a slug equal to the seed's 'ops-director' -> ok:false, no write.
vertical-existence guard (builder-owned): a valid kebab slug into a vertical not in the manifest -> ok:false. Slug valid so the slug guard passes first.
slug-shape guard (builder-owned, first in order): a non-kebab slug -> ok:false.
